author: (Greville) J.Agardh, 1851

note.en: A thin red crust on rock, known here from old specimens at Limón and near Puerto Limón.
note.es: Costra roja delgada sobre roca, conocida aquí por ejemplares antiguos de Limón y sus alrededores.

evidence: GBIF: 2 herbarium specimen record(s) in the region (1930 to 1930), e.g. Limón

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (herbarium specimens), Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: Old herbarium specimens at Limón only.

photos.by: Dawson, E.Y. 1953. Marine red algae of Pacific Mexico. Part 1. Bangiales to Corallinaceae subf. Corallinoidae. Allan Hancock Pacific Expeditions 17(1): 1–239, Plates 1-33.

marks.en: Thin red to brown crust that lies flat on rock like a sheet.
marks.es: Costra delgada de roja a parda que se pega a la roca como una lámina.
